title: Cash Receipt Template
description: Free cash receipt format for India with receipt no., received from, amount in figures and words, invoices settled, note denominations and revenue stamp box. Use it in Word, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Excel or Overleaf.
features: Amount in figures and words with invoice-wise settlement
Cash denomination breakdown and balance outstanding
Revenue stamp box for cash receipts above ₹5,000
useCases: Cash collected from customers against invoices
Advance or part payments received in cash
research: References agree on business details, receipt no. and date, payer name, amount in figures and words, purpose or invoice reference, payment mode, balance due and receiver's signature; Indian guidance adds a ₹1 revenue stamp signed across for cash receipts above ₹5,000.

groups.heading: Received from
lines: Paid by: [Mr. Suresh Patil, Site Supervisor]

blocks.text: Received with thanks from **[Deshmukh Builders Pvt. Ltd.]** the sum of **₹[41,480.00]** in cash towards full settlement of invoices [0311] and [0327] and part settlement of invoice [0345], as detailed above.
Amount received in words: **[Rupees Forty-One Thousand Four Hundred Eighty Only]**

blocks.heading: Notes
text: 1. Cash counted and received in the presence of the payer. Please check the amount before leaving the counter.
2. Invoice [INV/2026-27/0345] is part-paid; ₹[13,600.00] remains due by [15/12/2026].
3. This receipt is valid only with the receiver's signature. A ₹1 revenue stamp is affixed for cash receipts above ₹5,000.
4. Cash receipts are subject to the limits under Section 269ST of the Income-tax Act, 1961.
